input.answer:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That depends on your personal finances, savings, job stability, and how long you plan to stay, and it's personal financial advice, which is outside what I can provide. I also haven't pulled any Toronto price or rent figures for this answer, so I'm not giving you any numbers.

If you want to compare the data yourself, these Statistics Canada tables are relevant:
- Table 18-10-0205, New housing price index, monthly (covers new-home prices, including Toronto). Note that this is new-build pricing, not resale prices.
- Table 46-10-0092, Asking rent and paid rent prices, by rental unit type and number of bedrooms (quarterly, includes Toronto apartments).

A financial advisor or mortgage professional can help you weigh the buy-versus-rent decision against your own situation.
